description: This Java class defines a custom exception, DimensionMismatchException, used for indicating that two dimensions do not match in some operation within the Apache Commons Math library. It extends MathIllegalNumberException, includes constructors for creating exceptions with specific dimension details, and provides a getter method for retrieving the expected dimension.

classes.name: DimensionMismatchException
classes.description: Exception to be thrown when two dimensions differ. Stores the expected dimension and provides constructors for creating detailed exception instances.

methods.name: DimensionMismatchException(Localizable specific, int wrong, int expected)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with specific localization information, the wrong dimension, and the expected dimension.

methods.name: DimensionMismatchException(int wrong, int expected)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with just the wrong and expected dimensions, using a default localized message.

methods.name: getDimension()
methods.description: Returns the expected dimension associated with the exception.
